# Dunblane Highlands - Miniature Highland Cows

> Miniature Highland Cows for Sale in Australia. We breed premium, DNA-verified, halter-trained micro miniature and teacup highland calves.

## About Us
Dunblane Pastoral Holdings Pty Ltd is a premier breeder of miniature Scottish Highland cattle in Queensland (QLD 4725), Australia. We focus on preserving the heritage of Scottish Highland cattle in the Australian landscape. Our calves are docile, registered, and beautifully bred.

## Important Information
- **Location**: Queensland, Australia (QLD 4725)
- **Accreditations**: NLIS Registered Breeder, 100% DNA Parentage Verified.
- **Contact**: info@minihighlandcows.store
- **Phone**: 0468 187 340
- **Delivery**: Free delivery to the same city as the address. Farm visits are strictly by appointment.
- **Payments Accepted**: Pay ID, Bank Transfer, Credit Card & Crypto (USDT, BTC).

## Available Calves & Adoption Process
Check our website to view available micro, teacup, and miniature highland calves. The adoption process requires a formal reservation deposit, and we provide a health guarantee and sales contract for every calf.
